commands: jq 'if (.openapi and (.paths | length > 0)) then empty else error("getOpenAPI did not return an OpenAPI document - is the X-Road proxy running on port 8081?") end' _raw.tmp

jq '.paths |= with_entries(([.key | scan("[{]([^}]+)[}]")] | flatten) as $tmpl | .value |= with_entries(if (.key | test("^(get|post|put|patch|delete|head|options)$")) then .value.parameters |= (if . == null then . else map(if .in == "path" then (.name) as $n | ([$tmpl[] | select(ascii_downcase == ($n | ascii_downcase))] | first) as $m | if ($m != null and $m != $n) then .name = $m else . end else . end) end) else . end))' _raw.tmp > _.tmp && mv _.tmp _raw.tmp

jq 'if .paths["/api/RentalDays/{EntityId}/periods/{Period}"].get == null then error("GET /api/RentalDays/{EntityId}/periods/{Period} not found in the spec - see README, drop this patch if Skatturinn removed the endpoint") else . end | .paths["/api/RentalDays/{EntityId}/periods/{Period}"].get.responses["200"] |= (if has("content") then . else .content = {"application/json": {"schema": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/RentalDaysEntry"}}}} end)' _raw.tmp > _.tmp && mv _.tmp _raw.tmp
